scenarios.description: Release 104 reauthorized enterprise remediation completes with effective root-cause treatments, independently effective systemic controls, material risk reduction and a stable 180-day sustainability window.
A human-confirmed persistent systemic root cause remains ineffective after Release 104 treatment.
A repeatedly failing systemic control regresses after remediation execution.
Execution completes but systemic-risk reduction remains below the governed threshold.
AI or a worker attempts to accept residual risk, certify recovery, recertify recovery or reclose the program.
